verdict.rationale: Ollama provides its own headless surfaces suited to automation: a scriptable shell install, a REST API for running and managing models that can be called with curl, Python and JS libraries, and cloud models callable with just an API key. Community users run it as a server behind bots and in ROCm containers. No evidence explicitly covers CI usage, such as pipeline recipes, official container docs, or non-interactive automation guidance. missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline documentation, first-party headless/container deployment docs, independent hands-on CI corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Ollama has a REST API for running and managing models.
Learn the local and cloud base URLs, then send a request with curl.
Call cloud models with an API key. No Ollama installation required.
They have shipped ROCm containers since 0.1.27.
the ability to 'hotswap' models with different utility instead of restarting the server
